scope: Default-off QA integration and real local small ELF/process fixtures; no actual Android emulator executed
guardDetails: Exact default-off workflow selector and runtime environment guards reject other games/batches/original artifacts.
Original ELF retained at same-directory hard link, metadata/hash/mode recorded; atomic shim replacement and exact original restore.
Before AVD: original and wrapped -version require exit0, exact stdout/stderr equality, exact37.3.10.0/build16970787 and no timeout/truncation.
The upstream action catches pre-hook exceptions and may still try the restored original AVD; a mandatory assert-ready && gate prevents any QA on failed preparation.
Original argv0 and all AVD arguments are preserved and fixed. Whitelisted non-AVD queries exec the original directly.
Actual launcher child wait status is retained. QEMU exit remains null unless same PID/starttime and SDK-contained QEMU executable was observed. A forked launcher fixture remains unknown.
Original action stdout/stderr forwarding/listeners are retained; archived files each cap1MiB while remaining bytes are drained and hashed.
Existing host-kernel/environment diagnostics remain unchanged; no -show-kernel, GPU or RAM changes.
Supervisor cleanup signals require matching PID/starttime/executableSHA/command-lineSHA; signal escalation and cleanup intervention are explicit.
Installed SDK restore executes in always step before evidence preservation and refuses unexpected entry or backup bytes.
limitations: Actual Android launcher relocation/exec/fork behavior, native compatibility and actual emulator exit remain for root-controlled CI proof.
Query and signal tests use compiled small ELF fixtures, not the Android emulator.
SIGKILL of the supervisor itself or a hard runner/job termination can prevent a final report; no exit cause is inferred from that absence.
